description_en: Specifies a name for a CA certificate
kebab_example: aliyun slb set-ca-certificate-name --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ca-certificate-id 139a0000000-cn-east-hangzhou-01 --ca-certificate-name mycacert02 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetCACertificateName

parameters.help_en:
The region of the CA certificate.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
CA证书的地域。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CA certificate
parameters.name: ca_certificate_id

parameters.help_en:
The CA certificate name.

The name must be 1 to 80 character in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter
parameters.help_zh:
CA证书名称。

名称长度为1~80个英文或中文字符，必须以大小字母或中文开头，可包含数字，英文句号（.），下划线（_）和短横线（-）
parameters.name: ca_certificate_name
